# Symbols and sources

New-san: Paukatong et al., DOI 10.1002/jrs.70113, equations (1)–(13), SI (S1)–(S18).

$R$: Raman tensor in the displayed coordinate frame. (relative tensor units).
$d$: Common nonzero off-diagonal element in the cubic tensors. (relative tensor units).
$(h,k,\ell)$: Surface Miller indices. (dimensionless).
$M,N$: Normalization factors in SI (S2). (dimensionless).
$X,Y,Z$: Measurement unit axes in the crystal coordinates. (dimensionless).
$T$: Matrix with columns X, Y, Z. (dimensionless).
$\theta$: Linear-polarization scan angle. (radians).
$\alpha$: Detection-state scan angle. (radians).
$\beta,\beta'$: Jones-state phases in paper (11). (radians).
$\hat e_i,\hat e_s^*$: Incident column and conjugated detection row. (normalized).
$I$: Relative Raman intensity; plotted before optional normalization. (relative intensity units).
